{{Quote|What's going on in here?''"<br />"''Umm... We heard the order to fall in. Our squad was taken out en route by a droid cannon in the middle of town. We're all that's left. Sir.|The clone commander and Rayt, after the former caught the latter plundering a bank|<ref name="TPS" />}}
A '''clone trooper commander''' was an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was deployed to a [[Unidentified war-torn planet|planet]] held by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in order to oversee its pacification and obtain large sums of [[Currency/Legends|money]] from a Confederate bank. When the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] obtained the fund, he unwittingly brought aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminals [[Rayt (civilian)|Rayt]], [[Wes Apice]], and [[Bryn Apice]] disguised as [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], who were attempting to rob the bank themselves before escaping the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TPS" />
